name: Chicali Tacos
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each — and yes, the numbers in these questions are your real numbers.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your role at Chicali Tacos, and what makes your tacos worth crossing Las Vegas for.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before Panicci Ventures, what did your online presence look like — and what was that costing you in customers?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: Why did you trust Sammy and Panicci Ventures with your website and your Google presence?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: What does Panicci Ventures actually handle for you — the website, Google Business Profile, reviews, showing up in local search?

questions.label: Reviews
questions.text: Real numbers: you're sitting at a 4.8-star average on Google, and every single review has a personal reply. How much of that do you have to think about yourself?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — are new faces walking in saying they found you on Google?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from what you expected from a marketing guy — communication, speed, no lock-in contracts?

questions.label: Moment
questions.text: Is there a moment that made you think “okay, this is actually working” — a busy day, a customer story, an order spike?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another local food spot that's amazing at what they do but invisible online?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner of Chicali Tacos (Las Vegas). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. REVIEWS, MOMENT, and SAMMY are the hero clips; RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
